sources.details: One query per 30 profile keyword strings; sort:stars and 30 results requested. Additional topic and gap keywords are recorded below. GitHub connector substituted for unauthenticated gh CLI.
Topic queries and selected repository topics are recorded in the query and metadata logs.
Relevant client/node sections reviewed. Generic self-hosted app categories did not supply a further qualifying execution client.

Execution-client and open-source-alternative queries used these source families. AlternativeTo primarily surfaced hosted RPC services. The self-hosted directories did not add a qualified full-node client in the reviewed results.
Selected README/docs links supplied related forks, parent clients and renamed/superseded repositories. Source pins and README evidence URLs appear in competitors.json.
Used as API/product documentation references, never as closed-source code evidence. Hosting-billing vendors in the generic brief are not competitors to an execution client.

getamis/eth-client.found_via: GitHub search, topic and README snowball; topic:ethereum-client; topic:ethereum-client sort:stars
getamis/eth-client.reason: RPC client library rather than a blockchain node; last observed commit is from 2017.
getamis/eth-client.adoption_note: Star bands provide a reproducible adoption proxy; forks are recorded as context. Contributor counts were not fetched.

final_screening.XDCIndia/reth: Own sibling client; selected upstream Reth supplies external comparison evidence.
final_screening.other_topic_hits: Previously assessed node clients, SDKs, wallets, tutorials, docs or deployment helpers. No additional qualifying full-node candidate was established by this scoped pass.

closure: The scoped expansion added zero new selected clients after the 25-client set was assembled. This is not proof that the global competitor space is exhausted.
